reviewed_patch.construction: Concatenate git diff --binary --full-index BASE -- snapshot.rs and git diff --no-index --binary --full-index -- /dev/null tests/full_snapshot_empty_config.rs in reviewed_files order.

findings.subject: Empty-token equivalence
findings.reason: The branch runs only after the unchanged config signature/scan and typed-config retain. With zero tokens, resolve_config_links previously iterated zero times, returned no links, and build_config_link_units_from_snapshot returned Ok(Vec::new()) before any per-config filesystem reads. Skipping symbol/path cloning and lookup construction has the same returned data and no skipped durable writes.

findings.subject: All full adapters retain metadata and replacement semantics
findings.reason: build staging, temp DB, and DirectWriter all call prepare_full_snapshot_payload and write_full_snapshot_contents. The empty branch returns an empty config-unit list, not an early function return. Timestamp, filtered raw cache, signature, signature algorithm, file/route/hierarchy writes and graph-signature baseline remain on the common path. Snapshot replacement clears old config refs without requiring incremental per-file cleanup.

findings.subject: Typed configuration and nonempty token channels
findings.reason: Typed config filtering precedes the new branch. ProjectModel apply_imports/seal_modules/verify/acknowledge are unchanged. For nonempty tokens the same symbol collector, indexed path order and existing builder receive equal immutable inputs; ModulePath, FilePath and DependencyImport branches are unchanged.

findings.subject: Incremental stale-link cleanup
findings.reason: build_config_link_units_gated, seen_config_files construction including typed role transitions, Some(ConfigLinkRound) handling, apply_config_link_units and incremental metadata remain byte-identical to base. The full-then-incremental empty-cache lifecycle is covered by the new integration fixture.

findings.subject: Tests
findings.reason: The two added actual SQLite tests cover a previously linked INI becoming token-empty on full rebuild, empty-cache metadata, later source-only incremental and re-linking, and typed TS path resolution with an empty heuristic token population. The owner corrected only an invalid test SQL column name; the prior failed execution is retained.

owner_log_inspected.source_binding_limit: Source review pins the inspected final two-file bytes; this reviewer did not rerun the test command or independently construct its build receipt.

nonblocking_test_limits: The new public build_index integration tests execute the staged full-build path; they do not independently force the legacy temp-db and DirectWriter adapters. Common unchanged call structure supplies the static equivalence argument for those adapters.

The added tests do not independently assert all three nonempty token channels. Those branches and their existing three-channel serde regression are unchanged; normal targeted regressions should preserve their actual execution evidence.
The new tests check that the signature is a valid u64, not its exact value; the existing signature and unconditional-full-rescan regressions cover that separate contract.
not_claimed: No measured speedup, memory reduction, 100k completion, V20 gate, P8 task completion or release approval.
No independent execution of all full adapters, current CI, MSRV, source-guard approval or full workspace test suite.
rollback: Revert the single production snapshot.rs change and optional corresponding tests; no schema/config/metadata migration is introduced.
